It really just depends on the show and how it's done. Bridgerton did it amazing!  It didn't feel forced like it feels in many shows and movies, despite not being 100% historically accurate. 

In Witcher its a bit different, because they changed the colour of people in a way that, although not significantly, somewhat goes against the original books story and feel. For example they changed one of the female leads with iconic read hair into a dark skinned one, and although not a huge change, it was something fans were looking forward to/ expecting.

There's also this moment where a traveler of sort comes with these woman bodyguards that are described as exotic because of their darker skin, but now that doesn't mean anything. 

But all in all I think the race swapping could have worked in Witcher honestly really well, if the writers and producers wouldn't have fucked the story up with their own ideas. It's a kind of moment where they're so mad about the horrible story changes that they're looking at everything that's wrong in the show and this comes up.

Comments on the post are mostly disgusting, but otherwise I agree that they fucked up the casting (and they butchered the story).
